variant.title: Battenburg Sudoku
variant.description: A marked 2x2 checkerboard must alternate odd and even digits, and every such intersection is marked.
rule.battenburg: A marked 2x2 checkerboard contains alternating odd and even digits; an unmarked intersection cannot form that checkerboard.
rule_guide.title: Battenburg Sudoku
rule_guide.item_1: The four cells around a marked intersection must contain two odd and two even digits in a checkerboard pattern.
rule_guide.item_2: The marker does not choose which diagonal is odd. For example, both 1 2 / 4 3 and 2 1 / 3 4 follow the rule.
rule_guide.item_3: Every possible checkerboard intersection is marked. An unmarked intersection may not contain one.
